{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify one row per patient
n_patients = len(data_dedup)
print(f"Number of unique patients: {n_patients}")

# Identify assay_batch B samples
batch_b_mask = data_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B'
batch_b_count = batch_b_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of samples from assay_batch B: {batch_b_count}")

# Correct batch B values: divide by 10 (1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL)
data_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = data_dedup['biomarker_final']
# Apply correction only to batch B
batch_b_correction_factor = 10.0
print(f"Correction factor for assay_batch B: {batch_b_correction_factor}")
data_dedup.loc[batch_b_mask, 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= batch_b_correction_factor

# Compute mean of corrected biomarker_final
mean_biomarker_final = data_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()
print(f"Mean biomarker_final (corrected): {mean_biomarker_final}")"}
